target_customer: Airlines, shipping lines and fuel buyers that want zero net carbon drop-in fuels; later grid and defense energy storage customers
problem: Aviation, shipping and road fleets need liquid fuels, and low carbon alternatives were either too costly or needed new engines.
business_model: Fuel sales under offtake agreements, plus industrial systems (energy storage and containerized fuel units)
product_category: Electrofuels and direct air capture hardware

founders.name: Rob McGinnis
previous_startups: Two other venture-backed startups in nanotechnology and energy per the YC page
founders.background_notes: MIT Technology Review (2022) says he studied theater and worked as a playwright before the Yale PhD and calls him a showman. YC page claims over 20 patents.

competitors.name: Carbon Engineering
competitors.what: Direct air capture company with an Air to Fuels process combining captured CO2 and hydrogen into gasoline, diesel or jet fuel
competitors.funding_then: raised 68M dollars in 2019 from Chevron, Occidental and BHP after 30M earlier including Bill Gates

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs a novel integrated chain of CO2 capture, electrochemical conversion to alcohols, nanotube membrane separation and fuel synthesis; MIT Technology Review found no public demonstration of a fully integrated system by 2022.

defensibility.rationale: Proprietary process and patents claimed by the founder, but opaque and unverified; offtake deals with American Airlines and Boom add commercial positioning.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it; oil majors backed Carbon Engineering, which Occidental later bought, while Prometheus took BMW and Maersk money.

market_need_then: Aviation and shipping decarbonization pressure plus the drop-in fuel premise; Boom Supersonic partnered in June 2019 for a 2021 flight test fuel, and American Airlines agreed to 10 million gallons in 2021.

branding.name_origin: A trade article ties the name to the Prometheus fire myth, and the production module is called Titan Forge Alpha; the founder's own naming statement was not found.
branding.domain_note: Used prometheusfuels.com, now redirects to prometheusfuels.ai.

identity.logo: Red and white logo per company site
identity.voice_and_tone: Bold claims, tagline 'Redefining the future of energy'

branding.brand_signature: Promethean fire theme and the first electrofuels unicorn claim

rebrands.why: Not stated; the site now emphasizes energy storage and data center power

branding.community_and_virality: Podcast interviews and trade press; critics in MIT Technology Review question the claims.

brand_strength.rationale: Strong myth based name and press visibility helped win partners such as BMW and Maersk, offset by credibility doubts.

pivots.from: Retail gasoline and jet fuel from air
pivots.to: Energy storage as liquid fuel, off-grid fuel systems and defense units
pivots.why: Not stated; the 2026 company site describes ULDES, Fuel Forge systems and defense units

outcome_analysis: Prometheus raised from BMW i Ventures and a Series B in September 2021 that it said valued it at 1.5 billion dollars with Maersk and others, and signed offtake agreements. MIT Technology Review in April 2022 said it missed its 2020 price target, had not shown an integrated system publicly and drew expert skepticism. It remains active with new energy storage and defense products, so the final outcome is open.
notes: MIT Technology Review says the company reported over 50M raised, so recorded rounds (12.5M plus an undisclosed Series B) leave a gap. Aggregators show 11.5M Series B and 24.1M total, or 112.65M total; unverified. Founding year 2018 per YC, 2019 per others. The Biofuels Digest article returned 403 and was not opened. A SAF Investor article mentions an opened Series C, undated and unconfirmed. failure_factors tech_unsolved reflects reported lack of a demonstrated system, not a shutdown.
